script.base: Closing line is NYG +6, total 44.5, implied KC 25.2 / NYG 19.2, so the book has KC leading a moderate game, not a blowout and not a slog. Base flow: KC builds a one-score lead, stays balanced early (Mahomes already 13 carries/123 rush yards, Pacheco 15/47, Hunt 13/47), then runs late. NYG as a 6-point dog throws to stay attached: Nabers 25 targets/238 yards and Wan'Dale Robinson 18/197, while Tracy 15/39 and Skattebo 13/42 split a shrinking rush share.
script.flip1: KC jumps out early on a NYG run defense allowing 6.28 YPC and 12 runs of 10+. KC clocks it with Pacheco/Hunt, Mahomes and the WRs stall, and NYG abandons the run so Tracy/Skattebo rush lines die while Nabers/Robinson targets spike. Spread is only 6, so this is a flip; a real blowout would also risk KC starter snaps late.
script.flip2: NYG hangs around or leads. Wilson (11 carries, 67 rush yards) and Nabers explosives into a KC secondary without CB Kristian Fulton (out, ankle) keep a competitive or NYG-positive script, KC cannot just run, and Pacheco/Hunt carries stall. Second flip is weather: forecast not saved, so wind or rain could drag 44.5 into a slog.

Brown is KC's primary target (21/129/123 air) but his alignment vs the middle bleed is not charted. Nabers is NYG's primary and overlaps a Fulton-less secondary plus KC's right-side bleed, offset by the 48% blitz.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because flip 2 happened: Wilson and Nabers hit explosives with Fulton out, NYG played from in front, and Pacheco never got the late carries — Hunt and Mahomes kept the rush share and he finished in the teens on about 6 carries at 3.1 YPC. Even in a KC lead, 23.5 is only 1.5 above his week-2 total, so one stuff or a Mahomes scramble package wipes the over without the script being wrong. Tracy lost the under because the game stayed within a score, he got 11-12 carries, and one crease on a KC front missing Danna pushed him back to his week-1 24. The 19.5 line was already his mean, so the script had to cut volume and it did not. That counter is real but it is not the base case at KC -6 and 25.2 implied, so the legs stay unsized leans rather than passes.
slip_story: One story: KC controls a moderate-total game and runs late, NYG chases and does not run. Stack is Pacheco rushyds over 23.5 with Tracy rushyds under 19.5. Do not add KC WR overs (they need KC to keep throwing) or a total under (weather unknown, and 25-19 already fits 44.5). Nabers/Robinson overs fit the NYG-throws half but were passed, so they are not on this slip. No TDs, one market per player. No bet placed.
